subject.title: Dashboard: new data-binding kinds — stream, command, computed

question: Should dashboard data bindings include an interval command-execution source, or should command execution be split from stream/computed bindings until maintainers approve a separate allowlist and operator-permission model?
rationale: Automation cannot choose the product and security boundary for periodic command execution, and current main does not yet contain the dashboard substrate this feature would extend.

options.title: Split Command Security Design
options.body: Proceed with stream/computed binding design only after the dashboard substrate lands, and require a separate maintainer-approved proposal for command execution.

options.title: Approve All Three Binding Kinds
options.body: Accept stream, computed, and command bindings as one feature with the implementation carrying the full allowlist, permission, audit, and live-proof burden.

options.title: Defer Dashboard Apps Layer
options.body: Keep the roadmap item open but pause implementation until maintainers decide whether this modular dashboard layer belongs in bundled OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Split Command Security Design
recommendation.body: Proceed with stream/computed binding design only after the dashboard substrate lands, and require a separate maintainer-approved proposal for command execution.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam this roadmap builds on.
